title: Soul Of Braj Federation Interviewed Shri Aniruddhacharya Ji Maharaj | Dham Etiquettes and Message for Youth
description: The Soul of Braj Federation's team recently had an audience with Shri Aniruddhacharya Ji Maharaj in Vrindavan to seek guidance on the proper etiquettes that should be observed while in the holy Vrindavan Dham.The meeting was conducted as part of the broader Future of Vrindavan initiative (or similar programs like Vrindavan Civic Sense and community upliftment projects).​Purpose of the Meeting: The team asked Maharaj Ji to provide guidance on the essential etiquettes (maryada or vyavahar) that must be observed in the holy Vrindavan Dham.#SOBF ( Soul Of Braj Federation ) Team specifically asked about the etiquettes and proper conduct that devotees and visitors should maintain while in Vrindavan Dham.This meeting signifies the Federation's commitment to promoting seva (selfless service) and preserving the spiritual sanctity and culture of Braj.

title: Soul of Braj Federation and Dharm Raksha Sangh President Discuss Key Challenges: Civic Sense, Fraud, and Traffic Management in Vrindavan.
description: The management committee of the Soul of Braj Federation (SOBF) recently held a meeting in Vrindavan with Shri Saurabh Gaur ji, the National President of the Dharm Raksha Sangh. The engagement signifies a collaborative effort between the civic-minded organization and the religious-cultural body to address the multi-faceted challenges facing the holy Dham.​The discussions were anticipated to have centered on the following key areas concerning the spiritual sanctity, social welfare, and development of Vrindavan.Key topics included:✅️Civic Sense: Promoting public responsibility and maintaining cleanliness.✅️​Scams/Fraud: Ensuring the safety of pilgrims and residents from deception.✅️​Traffic Management: Advocating for solutions to ease severe congestion.✅️​Banning Alcohol: Reinforcing the complete ban on alcohol and non-vegetarian items to preserve the Dham's spiritual sanctity.The meeting aimed to create a unified front to preserve Vrindavan's Purity.

title: Brajkulam Nukkad Pathshala: A Hope for Underserved Children in Vrindavan
description: Many underserved children lack basic education. Through our Brajkulam Community Centre, we are launching 'Brajkulam Nukkad Pathshala' Centres in Shri Vrindavan Dham to support these children. These centres will provide education, food, and healthcare facilities. Our goal is to enroll 500+ underserved children within a year. We invite you and your company to join hands with us for the betterment of hundreds of children in Vrindavan.

title: Soul of Braj Federation and Barsana Dham Gurukulam Unite for Girls' Health & Hygiene
description: Soul of Braj Federation and Shri Barsana Dham Gurukulam Girls School have joined hands to promote health and hygiene initiatives for hundreds of girls in Shri Barsana Dham. As part of this initiative, we have opened a free Sanitary Pad Bank for all schoolgirls and will distribute Dettol soaps on a monthly basis.
